"Ravens X10" is about halfway through its run, with about half of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Today's free summary of "Ravens X10" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
808.headline: How far along this game is

809.body:
"Gold Bar Bingo" has five of seven top prizes left and is in the middle of its run. About a third of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Everything above about "Gold Bar Bingo" comes from the Maryland Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
